CoGra is invite-only — a member vouches for you, and \@%1$s\'s approval brings you in.
By creating your account you accept the Terms.
How CoGra handles your data: the Privacy Policy.
Waiting for a handle, your email and a password
That doesn\'t look like an email address.
A password is at least 12 characters.
A password is at most 128 characters.
That email already has an account.

Already have an account? Sign in
That didn\'t go through. Try again.
Too many tries. Wait a little, then try again.
Your identity on the graph is a key that exists only on this phone. A recovery code lets you restore it if this phone is ever lost — we store only an encrypted copy that the code unlocks.
Write this code down somewhere safe — on paper is best. It is shown only this once, and we can never recover it for you.

If this phone is lost or broken, your posts, relationships, and standing are permanently lost with it. Your login would survive, but the actor behind it can never be restored. You can create a backup later in Settings.
Can\'t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Your feed follows your own steps
Nothing is picked for you. What reaches you comes along the connections you made, one step at a time.
Give one with the pad: how much you are for it, and how much of it you want reaching you.
Posts, comments, opinions — and chats. Anything written on CoGra can be read, and cited, by anyone.
Posts and comments keep every layer they were built from. Pictures added, words changed — the whole history stays readable.
You are here because \@%1$s invited you. \@%1$s\'s link is your first way in to everyone else, and theirs to you.
Low tide at six tomorrow — anyone walking the flats?
Feels weird chatting where anyone can read it.
Nobody here pretends my thumbs have privacy. Meta and TikTok just read quieter.
At least our eavesdroppers can say hi.
This phone\'s signing key already belongs to another account. Sign in to that account to use it — a key can only ever back one account.
